description: Test suite for the error handling module related to Microsoft Teams (MSTeams) errors, covering error classification, formatting, and proxy revocation handling.

methods.name: formatUnknownError
methods.description: Formats unknown errors, returning the string representation or 'null' for null input.

methods.name: classifyMSTeamsSendError
methods.description: Classifies various MSTeams send errors based on status code and response content, returning an object with error kind and details.

methods.name: formatMSTeamsSendErrorHint
methods.description: Provides user-friendly hints for different classified errors.

methods.name: isRevokedProxyError
methods.description: Detects if an error is a proxy revoked error based on its message.

methods.name: withRevokedProxyFallback
methods.description: Runs an asynchronous operation with fallback logic for revoked proxy errors, logging when a revocation occurs.
